series.name: KTL2-G3 (single-phase 1-4 kW, on-grid, 140% DC overload)
series.notes: Manual prints plain two-digit IDs (01, 02, 05 ... 98) with no 'ID' prefix in the Code column. Codes unique to THIS table: ID24 is 'HwADErrIdc / Dc input current sampling error' here but 'Iac Rms Unbalance' on 1.1-3.3KTL-G3; ID30 is 'ConsistentVgrid' here but 'Sw OCP Instan' there; ID33 is 'GridPhase / The Grid Phase happen Mutation' here (single-phase name, grid phase mutation) and absent on the G3 table. Do not merge with SERIES 3.

meaning.en: String Vmp is below the inverter's minimum operating voltage. Manual fix: add series modules to raise the string voltage into the input range.
meaning.ur: String ka Vmp inverter ki minimum operating voltage se neeche hai. Manual ka hal: series mein modules barhayein takay string voltage input range mein aa jaye.

causes.en: Too few modules in series to reach the MPPT operating window.
causes.ur: MPPT operating window tak pohanch karne ke liye series mein modules kam hain.

causes.en: Cold-start or wake-up on a string whose Voc is marginal at low irradiance.
causes.ur: Cold-start ya wake-up aisi string par jiska Voc kam irradiance par marginal hai.

solutions.en: Measure the string's Vmp with a multimeter and compare it to the datasheet MPPT lower limit.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se string ka Vmp measure karke datasheet MPPT ki lower limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: If Voc is normal, it is just low irradiance - the unit recovers automatically as sun returns.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc normal hai to sirf kam irradiance hai - dhoop aate hi unit khud recover ho jata hai.

solutions.en: If Voc is genuinely low, add series modules to bring the string into the input voltage range.
solutions.ur: Agar Voc asal mein kam hai to series mein modules barha kar string ko input voltage range mein layein.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

meaning.en: String Voc exceeds the inverter's maximum input voltage, so the unit will not start. Manual fix: reduce the number of series modules.
meaning.ur: String ka Voc inverter ke maximum input voltage se upar hai, is liye unit start nahi hoga. Manual ka hal: series modules ki sankhya kam karein.

causes.en: String count chosen on a cold-climate Voc that does not suit this site.
causes.ur: String ki sankhya thande climate ke Voc par chuni gayi jo is site ke liye theek nahi.

causes.en: Higher-Voc modules substituted after the original design.
causes.ur: Original design ke baad higher-Voc modules lagaye gaye.

solutions.en: Measure string Voc with a multimeter on the coldest clear morning you can get.
solutions.ur: Sab se thanda aur saaf subah mein multimeter se string ka Voc measure karein.

solutions.en: Recalculate the maximum series count for the site minimum temperature and remove modules until it fits.
solutions.ur: Site ki minimum temperature par maximum series count dobara calculate karein aur modules nikal dein jab tak fit na ho.

solutions.en: Confirm the corrected Voc is under the inverter maximum before re-energising the DC switch.
solutions.ur: DC switch dobara on karne se pehle confirm karein ke corrected Voc inverter max se neeche hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

title.ur: GFCI leakage fault - residual current trip hua (12)

meaning.en: Residual current fault. Manual says occasional events mean the external circuit was momentarily abnormal; frequent events mean low PV array insulation.
meaning.ur: Residual current fault. Manual ke mutabiq occasional event ka matlab external circuit mein palay waqt ghalti thi; frequent event ka matlab PV array ki insulation kam hai.

causes.en: PV array to earth insulation too low because of moisture on modules or cable.
causes.ur: Module ya cable par moisture ki wajah se PV array se earth ki insulation kam.

causes.en: A wet connector or junction box allowing leakage to earth.
causes.ur: Geela connector ya junction box earth mein leakage de raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then measure PV array insulation to earth.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker off karke 5 minute wait karke PV array ki earth ke saath insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: If the fault is frequent and lasts a long time, check PV array to earth insulation and then the PV cable insulation condition.
solutions.ur: Agar fault baar baar aaye aur deri tak rahe to PV array se earth ki insulation aur phir PV cable ki insulation check karein.

solutions.en: Replace or reseal the leaking part, then re-measure before closing the DC switch.
solutions.ur: Leaking hissa replace ya reseal karein, phir DC switch band karne se pehle dobara measure karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

title.ur: DC input current sampling error - current sensing kharab (24)

meaning.en: The DC input current sensor or its sampling circuit is reporting wrongly. Manual classes ID15-ID24 as internal inverter faults handled by a DC switch off / 5 min / on cycle.
meaning.ur: DC input current sensor ya us ka sampling circuit ghalat reading de raha hai. Manual ID15-ID24 ko internal inverter faults batata hai jinke liye DC switch off, 5 min, on ka cycle hai.

causes.en: Current sense resistor or hall sensor failure on the control board.
causes.ur: Control board par current sense resistor ya hall sensor fail.

causes.en: Sampling circuit noise or a cold solder joint on the measurement board.
causes.ur: Measurement board par sampling circuit ka noise ya cold solder joint.

solutions.en: Turn the DC switch OFF, wait 5 minutes, then turn it back ON and check whether the fault is rectified.
solutions.ur: DC switch OFF karein, 5 minute wait karein, phir wapas ON karke dekhein ke fault theek hua ya nahi.

solutions.en: If it returns, compare the inverter's reported DC current against a clamp meter on the PV cable.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to PV cable par clamp meter se liye reading aur inverter ki reported DC current compare karein.

solutions.en: A large mismatch confirms a failed sense channel - log events and raise a service/warranty case.
solutions.ur: Bara farq sense channel fail hone ki tasdeeq karta hai - events note karke service/warranty case karein.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

meaning.en: The phase of the measured grid voltage has changed. This code only appears in this KTL2-G3 table. Manual action: the phase of the grid voltage has changed.
meaning.ur: Measured grid voltage ka phase badal gaya hai. Yeh code sirf is KTL2-G3 table par hai. Manual ka action: grid voltage ka phase badal gaya hai.

causes.en: Two phases or neutral swapped at the AC input, so the inverter sees a different phase angle.
causes.ur: AC input par do phases ya neutral swap ho gaya, is liye inverter ko alag phase angle nazar aata hai.

causes.en: Loose neutral connection causing phase reference to float.
causes.ur: Loose neutral connection ki wajah se phase reference float kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the AC breaker and inspect phase and neutral terminations for swapped or loose conductors.
solutions.ur: AC breaker off karke phase aur neutral connections ke liye swapped ya loose wires dekhein.

solutions.en: Confirm the phase rotation matches the grid with a phase rotation meter before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Dobara current dene se pehle phase rotation meter se confirm karein ke phase rotation grid se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Re-torque the neutral particularly - a loose neutral is the usual trigger for this code.
solutions.ur: Khaas kar neutral dobara tighten karein - loose neutral hi is code ki aam wajah hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

meaning.en: Insulation between the PV array and earth is too low. Manual fix: check resistance and rectify any short circuit.
meaning.ur: PV array aur earth ke darmiyan insulation bohat kam hai. Manual ka hal: resistance check karke short circuit theek karein.

causes.en: Moisture on module backs or inside the junction box after rain or monsoon.
causes.ur: Barish ya monsoon ke baad module ke peeche ya junction box ke andar moisture.

causes.en: Cable insulation abraded against a roof edge, bracket or a metal edge.
causes.ur: Chhat ke kinare, bracket ya metal edge par cable ki insulation ghisat hui.

solutions.en: Open DC switch and AC breaker, wait 5 minutes, then measure insulation from the PV array to earth.
solutions.ur: DC switch aur AC breaker open karke 5 minute wait karke PV array se earth tak insulation measure karein.

solutions.en: If a short circuit occurs, rectify the fault - find it by testing each string separately.
solutions.ur: Agar short circuit ho to ghalti theek karein - har string ko alag alag test kar ke dhoondhein.

solutions.en: Replace the damaged cable or module and confirm insulation is high again before closing the DC switch.
solutions.ur: Damaged cable ya module replace karein aur DC switch band karne se pehle confirm karein ke insulation dobara zyada hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

title.ur: Meter communication error - meter se baat nahi ho rahi (64)

meaning.en: The smart meter stopped communicating. The manual is specific that this is reported when the ARM receives a meter communication exception bit and the safety country is Australia - check the site meter and country setting.
meaning.ur: Smart meter ka communication toot gaya. Manual mutauri hai ke ye tab report hota hai jab ARM ko meter communication exception bit milta hai aur safety country Australia ho - site meter aur country setting check karein.

causes.en: RS485 line to the meter disconnected, reversed (A/B swapped) or unterminated.
causes.ur: Meter ki RS485 line disconnect, reverse (A/B swap) ya open-ended.

causes.en: Meter modbus address or baud rate not matching the inverter setting.
causes.ur: Meter ka modbus address ya baud rate inverter setting se match nahi karta.

causes.en: Country code set to a profile that expects a different meter behaviour.
causes.ur: Country code aise profile par set jo alag meter behaviour expect karta hai.

solutions.en: Power off and check the meter RS485 A and B at both ends for correct pairing and seating.
solutions.ur: Power off karke meter RS485 A aur B dono taraf se pairing aur seating check karein.

solutions.en: Re-enter the meter modbus address on the LCD and confirm the meter is on the same RS485 bus as the inverter.
solutions.ur: LCD par meter ka modbus address dobara daalein aur confirm karein ke meter inverter ke usi RS485 bus par hai.

solutions.en: Verify the country code matches the local DISCO grid profile, since the meter error logic depends on it.
solutions.ur: Country code local DISCO grid profile se match karwayein, kyunke meter error logic usi par depend karta hai.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list

title.ur: SD card fault - SD card nahi chal raha (98)

meaning.en: The SD card is not readable. Manual instruction: 'Please replace the SD card.'
meaning.ur: SD card readable nahi hai. Manual ka instruction: 'Please replace the SD card.'

causes.en: Card loose, bent, or inserted in the wrong orientation.
causes.ur: Card loose, tangi ya galat direction mein lagi hui.

causes.en: Card corrupted by a power cut during a data write.
causes.ur: Data write ke dauran power cut se card corrupt hua.

solutions.en: Power off the inverter, reseat the SD card firmly in the correct orientation.
solutions.ur: Inverter power off karke SD card sahi direction mein mazbooti se dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Fit a new FAT32 card; the manual says replace, not reformat.
solutions.ur: Naya FAT32 card lagayein; manual kehta hai replace karein, format nahi.

solutions.en: If a new card also faults, the card reader on the board has failed and needs service.
solutions.ur: Agar naya card bhi fault de to board ka card reader fail hai aur service chahiye.

source.title: SOFAR 1~4KTL2-G3 User Manual, 'Trouble shooting', Table 7-1 Even list
